meta.name: orchestration
meta.description: Coordinate supervised Orca workers: threaded messages, blocking ask/reply, task dispatch, worker_done/escalation waits, task DAGs, decision gates, coordinator loops, and decomposing work across agents. Use `orca-cli` for full ownership handoffs — "hand off", "handoff", "handover", "give this to another agent", "another worktree" — unless asked to supervise, monitor, or coordinate a DAG, and for terminal control, lightweight terminal prompts, shell commands, Orca worktree management, and reading or waiting on terminals.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把复杂工作拆成多个环节,派给多个助手并行执行并汇总结果
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果任务太重,想拆给多个 AI 助手分头做完再统一汇总。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if a task is too big to do alone and you want several assistants to split it and report back.

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 可以协调受监督的 Orca worker:收发线程消息、阻塞式 ask/reply 问答、派发任务、等待 worker_done 或升级、按任务 DAG 和决策门推进协调循环。
howto.when: 当你需要结构化的多智能体协调(线程消息、任务派发、任务 DAG 等)时接管;若只是完整移交所有权,则走 orca-cli 技能。

say.text: 把这个任务派发给那个 worker,并等它做完
say.note: 经 Orca 派发任务,阻塞等待 worker_done

say.text: 问一下另一个 worker 的进度,等它回复
say.note: 走阻塞式 ask/reply 流程

say.text: 建一个任务 DAG,按依赖顺序推进
say.note: 按协调循环逐个执行节点

howto.what_en: Claude coordinates supervised Orca workers: threaded messages, blocking ask/reply, task dispatch, worker_done and escalation waits, task DAGs, decision gates, and coordinator loops.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you need structured multi-agent coordination such as threaded messages, task dispatch, or task DAGs; plain ownership handoffs go to the orca-cli skill instead.

say_en.text: Dispatch this task to that worker and wait until it's done.
say_en.note: Sends the task via Orca and blocks on worker_done

say_en.text: Ask the other worker for its progress and wait for the reply.
Build a task DAG and run it in dependency order.
say_en.note: Runs the nodes through the coordinator loop
